name: Prodia
summary: Fast image and video generation inference (FLUX, SDXL, Seedream, Veo, Kling, Wan and more) through one job endpoint.

token.description: A Prodia API token from the API dashboard (app.prodia.com/api). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Every job is {type, config}: type names the model and task (e.g. inference.flux-fast.schnell.txt2img.v2, inference.veo.fast.txt2vid.v1) and config holds that type's fields. Job types and their configs are listed in the docs and the explorer (app.prodia.com/explorer).
Jobs that need input images or video send them as multipart parts, which this catalog cannot send; text-only jobs go as JSON.
Add price=true to get the job's cost in dollars in its result (only on success).
429 means no capacity or too many async jobs; honour Retry-After.
Async job results expire 1 hour after creation (404 after that); download outputs promptly. Output files are served by GET /v2/job/async/{id}/output/{filename} as raw bytes.

endpoints.name: Run a generation job (synchronous)
endpoints.summary: Runs one job and blocks until done; the answer is the output file, or a multipart job + output.

config.description: Type-specific configuration, e.g. {prompt: ...}; most generation types require at least a prompt.

example.prompt: grainy photograph of a space explorer

price.description: true adds price {product, dollars} to the job result.

accept.description: Output format: an image or video type (image/jpeg, image/png, video/mp4) for the raw file, or multipart/form-data for the job JSON plus output.

notes: A read over POST that is billed per job (see the pricing page). Video can take minutes: use prodia.job.start instead.

endpoints.name: Start an async generation job
endpoints.summary: Creates a job and returns at once with its id and state (processing).

example.prompt: Running in the woods with a dog.

price.description: true adds price to the finished job's result.

notes: A read over POST that is billed per job. Beta. Not every job type allows async (400 says to use the sync API). Poll prodia.job.state until processed or failed.

endpoints.name: Get an async job's state
endpoints.summary: Plain-text state: processing, processed or failed.
notes: Success is processed (not completed, as on the sync API).

endpoints.name: Get an async job's metadata
endpoints.summary: Full job JSON: config, timestamps, metrics, price and error details.

endpoints.name: List an async job's output files
endpoints.summary: The output files a finished job produced, to download by filename.
